items.name: dga
items.title: Platform Code
items.description: Sets up Platform Code: the DGA style and tokens, Hugeicons, RTL, and the @dga registry in components.json.
items.docs: DGA style installed. Set <html dir="rtl" lang="ar"> for Arabic, and use data-theme="dark" or the .dark class for dark mode. Docs: https://dga.omqkhafi.dev/docs

items.name: dga-style
items.title: DGA style
items.description: DGA style: Base UI, Hugeicons, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, the cn helper and the cn-* component style map. Pulls in dga-tokens.
items.docs: DGA style installed. Set <html dir="rtl" lang="ar"> for Arabic, and use data-theme="dark" or the .dark class for dark mode. Docs: https://dga.omqkhafi.dev/docs

items.name: dga-tokens
items.title: DGA tokens
items.description: Every DGA design token as CSS variables: light and dark themes, responsive modes, the Tailwind v4 theme and the shadcn variable mapping. Install on its own to use the tokens without components.

:root.--primitive-font-family-display: var(--font-sans, "IBM Plex Sans Arabic"), system-ui, sans-serif
:root.--primitive-font-family-text: var(--font-sans, "IBM Plex Sans Arabic"), system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn helper, re-exported from the cn package (replaces clsx + tailwind-merge).

items.name: font-ibm-plex-sans-arabic
items.title: IBM Plex Sans Arabic
items.description: The DGA typeface for Arabic and Latin, weights 400 to 700.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: DGA Loading indicator: seven sizes, primary, neutral and on-colour.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: DGA Button on Base UI: primary, neutral, secondary, outline, subtle and transparent, destructive and on-colour, three sizes, icon-only and loading.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: DGA Link: primary, neutral and on-colour, two sizes, inline, external and disabled. Works with Next.js Link through the render prop.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: DGA Badge (from the design.dga.gov.sa CSS): seven colours and on-colour, filled or outlined, sm/md/lg, rounded and icon-only.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: DGA Tag and Status Tag: neutral, success, info, warning, error and on-colour; filled or outlined; xs/sm/md; rounded, icon-only and dismissible. Status Tag: subtle, inverted and ghost with a dot.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: DGA Divider on Base UI Separator: neutral, primary, alpha-white and white; horizontal or vertical.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: DGA Avatar on Base UI: image, initials or icon, 24 to 120px, circle or square, optional ring; Avatar Group stacked or spaced.

items.name: featured-icon
items.title: Featured Icon
items.description: DGA Featured Icon (from the design.dga.gov.sa CSS): light, hard and outlined in six colours, sm to xl, square or circle.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: DGA Skeleton: rectangle, square, circle and line placeholders in the Figma sizes. Static with reduced motion.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: DGA Field on Base UI Field and Fieldset: label with required or optional marker, helper text, error with icon, horizontal layout for checkbox, radio and switch, grouping with legend.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: DGA Text Input on Base UI Input: md 32px and lg 40px, default, lighter and darker fills, prefix and suffix, hover, focus, read-only, disabled and error.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: DGA Textarea on Base UI Field: default, lighter and darker fills, resizable, hover, focus, read-only, disabled and error.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: DGA Checkbox on Base UI: primary and neutral, 16, 20 and 24px, checked, indeterminate, read-only, disabled and error.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: DGA Radio and Radio Group on Base UI: primary and neutral, selected, read-only, disabled and error, arrow-key navigation.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: DGA Switch on Base UI: 48x24px, optional check icon, hover, focus, read-only, disabled and error. Moves on the logical axis in RTL.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: DGA Dropdown Input on Base UI Select: md and lg, default, lighter and darker fills, grouped options, check mark on the chosen option, hover, open, read-only, disabled and error.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: DGA Number Input on Base UI Number Field: left-to-right isolated digits, Arabic-Indic digit input normalised to Western, - and + buttons on the logical sides, min, max and step.

items.name: search-box
items.title: Search Box
items.description: DGA Search Box on Base UI Input: search icon on the start side, clear button on the end side, md and lg, Escape clears.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: DGA File Upload: keyboard-accessible drag-and-drop zone, file list with remove, progress and error states, type, size and count validation, Arabic file names.
